❯ what is 17 again

● #17 stops the recipe app from showing stale thumbnails after a photo is replaced, the bug that started this thread. It adds the photo's checksum to the thumbnail's file name.

  Thumbnails were cached by recipe id alone, so a new photo kept the old picture until the cache expired a week later. It's a 6-line change, and I
  tested it locally: with the checksum the new photo shows at once, without it the old one stays.

  The 6:00 AM rebuild runs main, which doesn't have this fix. So tomorrow's site will still serve the stale thumbnails. Merging #17 is what fixes it for
  everyone.
